CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.stock_envase_mutation_gate_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET lock_timeout TO '3s'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_LEVEL<>'STATEMENT' OR TG_WHEN<>'BEFORE' OR TG_OP NOT IN ('INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE','TRUNCATE')
 OR TG_RELID NOT IN ('public.organizations'::regclass,'public.organization_subscriptions'::regclass,'public.saas_plan_versions'::regclass,'public.saas_plan_version_features'::regclass,'public.saas_features'::regclass,'public.saas_modules'::regclass,'public.organization_feature_overrides'::regclass,'public.clientes'::regclass,'public.programacao_producao'::regclass,'public.ordens_servico'::regclass,'public.lotes'::regclass,'public.controle_qualidade'::regclass,'public.estoque_produto'::regclass) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ENVASE_GATE_CONTEXT_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 -- Existing upstream RPCs can prelock business rows before their first DML.
 -- Never wait here while owning those rows: reject contention atomically instead
 -- of closing the singleton/business-row deadlock cycle.
 PERFORM 1 FROM cf_user_guards_v1.state WHERE singleton FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'STOCK_GATE_UNAVAILABLE' USING ERRCODE='PT503'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_cq_resultado_imutavel()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Sem excecao por GUC: autoria e imutabilidade valem em todas as chamadas.
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    IF OLD.resultado IS NOT NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'CQ_RESULTADO_FINAL_IMUTAVEL: análise % do lote % já possui resultado final (%) e não pode ser excluída. Registre uma nova análise (reanálise) para o mesmo lote.',
        OLD.id, OLD.lote_id, OLD.resultado USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
    END IF;
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;

  -- transição inicial (pendente -> resultado final) continua permitida
  IF OLD.resultado IS NULL THEN
    IF NEW.lote_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.lote_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'CQ_LOTE_IMUTAVEL: não é permitido mover a análise de CQ para outro lote.'
        USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.resultado      IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.resultado
     OR NEW.lote_id        IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.lote_id
     OR NEW.responsavel_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.responsavel_id
     OR NEW.responsavel    IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.responsavel
     OR NEW.data_analise   IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.data_analise
     OR NEW.created_at     IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at
     OR NEW.seq            IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.seq
     OR NEW.ph             IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ph
     OR NEW.aparencia      IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.aparencia
     OR NEW.odor           IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.odor
     OR NEW.concentracao   IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.concentracao
     OR NEW.contaminacao   IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.contaminacao
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CQ_RESULTADO_FINAL_IMUTAVEL: a análise % do lote % já foi finalizada (%). Registre uma NOVA análise (reanálise) para o mesmo lote em vez de sobrescrever o histórico.',
      OLD.id, OLD.lote_id, OLD.resultado USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_h6c_entrega_ar_b2b_link()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_po public.partner_orders%ROWTYPE;
  v_settings record;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.receivable_id IS NULL
     OR NEW.partner_order_id IS NULL
     OR NEW.receivable_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.receivable_id THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_po FROM public.partner_orders WHERE id = NEW.partner_order_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;

  -- 1) o recebível passa a pertencer ao parceiro (entra em saldo_em_aberto)
  UPDATE public.accounts_receivable
     SET partner_id = v_po.partner_id
   WHERE id = NEW.receivable_id AND partner_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_po.partner_id;

  -- 2) vínculo financeiro canônico (idempotente: unique em partner_order_id)
  SELECT * INTO v_settings FROM public.partner_financial_settings WHERE partner_id = v_po.partner_id;
  INSERT INTO public.partner_order_financial_links(
    partner_order_id, partner_id, receivable_id, financial_status, billing_trigger, created_by)
  VALUES (v_po.id, v_po.partner_id, NEW.receivable_id, 'gerado',
          COALESCE(v_settings.billing_trigger, 'entrega'), NEW.billing_generated_by)
  ON CONFLICT (partner_order_id) DO NOTHING;

  -- 3) pedido deixa de ser "comprometido não faturado"
  UPDATE public.partner_orders
     SET financial_status = 'gerado',
         receivable_generated = true,
         receivable_generated_at = COALESCE(receivable_generated_at, now()),
         receivable_generated_by = COALESCE(receivable_generated_by, NEW.billing_generated_by)
   WHERE id = v_po.id AND COALESCE(receivable_generated,false) = false;

  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

triggers.trigger_definition: CREATE TRIGGER aa_manual_lot_write_fence_v1 BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.lotes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION platform_private.guard_manual_lot_write_v1()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.guard_manual_lot_write_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
 p public.programacao_producao%ROWTYPE;
 old_manual boolean:=false;
 old_programacao uuid;
 org uuid;
BEGIN
 -- Lock old/new parents in deterministic order. An UPDATE cannot escape the
 -- manual fence by changing programacao_id to onfarm or NULL.
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN old_programacao:=OLD.programacao_id; END IF;
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.programacao_producao
 WHERE id=NEW.programacao_id OR id=old_programacao
 ORDER BY id FOR SHARE;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
  SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.programacao_producao
    WHERE id=OLD.programacao_id AND ordem_servico_id IS NOT NULL) INTO old_manual;
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO p FROM public.programacao_producao WHERE id=NEW.programacao_id;
 IF old_manual OR p.ordem_servico_id IS NOT NULL OR p.id IS NULL THEN
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND old_manual THEN
   org:=platform_private.h15_actor_organization();
   IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND org IS NOT NULL AND public.technical_actor_ready(auth.uid()) IS TRUE
    AND (public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador') OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'gestor') OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'producao')) IS TRUE
    AND p.id IS NOT NULL AND p.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NULL AND p.organization_id=org AND NEW.organization_id=org AND OLD.organization_id=org
    AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-'status'-'updated_at') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'status'-'updated_at')
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.ordens_servico o JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=o.cliente_id
     WHERE o.id=p.ordem_servico_id AND o.organization_id=org AND c.organization_id=org AND o.status::text='em_cq'
     AND o.partner_order_id IS NULL AND o.partner_order_item_id IS NULL AND o.origem IS DISTINCT FROM 'b2b')
    AND ((OLD.status::text='em_producao' AND NEW.status::text='aguardando_cq' AND p.status::text='aguardando_cq'
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.authz_tickets WHERE txid=txid_current() AND scope='manual_cq_send_v1' AND target=NEW.id))
     OR (OLD.status::text='aguardando_cq' AND NEW.status::text IN ('aprovado','reprovado') AND p.status::text='aguardando_cq'
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.authz_tickets WHERE txid=txid_current() AND scope='manual_cq_'||NEW.status::text||'_v1' AND target=NEW.id)
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.controle_qualidade c WHERE c.lote_id=NEW.id AND c.organization_id=org AND c.resultado::text=NEW.status::text
      AND c.responsavel='DADOS FICTICIOS SEM VALOR COMERCIAL' AND c.ph IS NOT NULL AND c.concentracao IS NOT NULL)))
   THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  END IF;

  -- No JWT/GUC/current_user/service-role escape: only the reviewed insert RPC
  -- can issue this private, target-specific ticket; it removes it after INSERT.
  org:=platform_private.h15_actor_organization();
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR org IS NULL OR auth.uid() IS NULL
   OR public.technical_actor_ready(auth.uid()) IS NOT TRUE
   OR p.id IS NULL OR p.ordem_servico_id IS NULL OR p.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NOT NULL
   OR p.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM org OR NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM org
   OR p.produto_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.produto_id OR p.microrganismo_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.microrganismo_id
   OR p.status::text IS DISTINCT FROM 'aguardando' OR NEW.status::text IS DISTINCT FROM 'em_producao'
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.ordens_servico o JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=o.cliente_id
     WHERE o.id=p.ordem_servico_id AND o.organization_id=org AND c.organization_id=org
     AND o.status::text='programada' AND o.partner_order_id IS NULL AND o.partner_order_item_id IS NULL
     AND o.origem IS DISTINCT FROM 'b2b')
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.authz_tickets
     WHERE txid=pg_catalog.txid_current() AND scope='manual_lot_insert_v1' AND target=NEW.id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MANUAL_LOT_WRITE_REQUIRES_REVIEWED_RPC' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.stock_envase_mutation_gate_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET lock_timeout TO '3s'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_LEVEL<>'STATEMENT' OR TG_WHEN<>'BEFORE' OR TG_OP NOT IN ('INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE','TRUNCATE')
 OR TG_RELID NOT IN ('public.organizations'::regclass,'public.organization_subscriptions'::regclass,'public.saas_plan_versions'::regclass,'public.saas_plan_version_features'::regclass,'public.saas_features'::regclass,'public.saas_modules'::regclass,'public.organization_feature_overrides'::regclass,'public.clientes'::regclass,'public.programacao_producao'::regclass,'public.ordens_servico'::regclass,'public.lotes'::regclass,'public.controle_qualidade'::regclass,'public.estoque_produto'::regclass) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ENVASE_GATE_CONTEXT_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 -- Existing upstream RPCs can prelock business rows before their first DML.
 -- Never wait here while owning those rows: reject contention atomically instead
 -- of closing the singleton/business-row deadlock cycle.
 PERFORM 1 FROM cf_user_guards_v1.state WHERE singleton FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'STOCK_GATE_UNAVAILABLE' USING ERRCODE='PT503'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$
